description: The graph illustrates the performance of various trajectory prediction models, measured by the minimum Final Displacement Error (minFDE₂₀), across different ratios of training data. The x-axis represents the "Ratio" of training data used, ranging from 0.2 to 1.0, while the y-axis shows the minFDE₂₀, with lower values indicating better performance. The plot includes five models: TrajICL (blue line with circular markers), Head Tuning (orange line with circular markers), FT (green line with circular markers), LoRA 16 (red line with circular markers), and LoRA 64 (purple line with circular markers). TrajICL shows a consistent decrease in minFDE₂₀ as the ratio increases, starting from approximately 20.3 at a ratio of 0.2 and ending near 19.8 at a ratio of 1.0. Head Tuning starts at a minFDE₂₀ of about 22.9 and gradually decreases to around 22.3. FT begins at approximately 22.2 and decreases to about 21.0. LoRA 16 starts at around 22.9 and decreases to about 22.1. LoRA 64 starts at approximately 22.9 and decreases to around 22.1. All models exhibit a general downward trend in error as the ratio increases, indicating improved performance with more training data.
